Subject: May 6: Sales/FinOps/Infra orientation — GPU runway & reservation ramp

Team —

I'm consolidating the weekly orientation for Sales / FinOps / Infra to align on a fast-moving request from Acme AI (pilot -> potential annual dedicated). Goal: land a clear reservation ramp and fallback plan so Sales can give an unambiguous timeline and burn estimate.

Quick context: Acme is targeting a 3-week pilot (starts mid-May) that will require predictable p99 latency under 300ms for 2k concurrent users at peak; they're asking about a dedicated pool and a phased reservation (pilot -> 25% committed first quarter -> scale depending on telemetry).

Attached: 20290506-runway-forecast-v2.xlsx (my working forecast).

Asks by EOD Wed (May 8):
- FinOps (Laura): confirm model-level TCO ranges for the three commitment tiers and highlight where we can offer credits/discounts for a pilot-to-annual conversion. Reference: sheet tab "TCO-scenarios".
- Infra (Karthik/Marcus): what is earliest delivery for a dedicated pool sized for the pilot (GPU type + node count), and what fallback runbook do we recommend if capacity is constrained? Include burst/queue SLAs and warm-up KV cache guidance.
- Sales (me): I will coordinate a single customer-facing doc and a follow-up call once we have numbers.

Please reply inline with the key numbers and any constraints. If something needs an immediate sync, propose a 30-min slot tomorrow 11–12 PT.

Ben

ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Thanks Ben — quick response from FinOps side. I reviewed your forecast and added a new tab "Reserve-pricing" in the spreadsheet. High-level:

- Pilot (3 weeks): recommend we treat as an unpaid pilot with a small refundable deposit to cover standby costs. Estimated net cost to Redwood ~ $8.8k (NVIDIA H100-equivalent) for baseline (no burst).
- Quarter-1 commit (25%): effective discount ~18% off list model price if they commit 3 months; this nets a predictable minimum monthly revenue.
- Annual conversion (>= 65% of peak): scale discount to 30% with an SLA uplift (4 nines regional uptime for dedicated pools).

I attached a short breakdown: reserve-pricing-deltas.pdf (non-confidential). Two finance notes:
1) We can only extend the deepest discounts after legal signs off on minimum revenue clauses.
2) For pilot -> annual conversions, propose a 60-day matching credit window (helps Sales close).

Action items for me: finalize the TCO table and publish to Drive by Wed 5/8 5pm PT.

Laura Bennett | Director, FinOps
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: reserve-pricing-deltas.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 May 2029 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: May 6: Sales/FinOps/Infra orientation — GPU runway & reservation ramp

Looping in infra constraints and a pragmatic delivery plan. Summary:

- Earliest dedicated pool for pilot: 2029-05-20 (two H100p nodes, total 16 A100-class vGPUs equivalent in our packing). This assumes no conflicting reserved launches the same week.
- If capacity is tight: fallback A = shared-hosted with pinned model variant + auto-burst (guaranteed baseline tokens, burst throttles); fallback B = cross-region routing to eu-west with latency table for customer signoff.
- Warm-up recommendations: pre-cache top 10 prompt prefixes + a 1-hour warm-up traffic generator to prime KV cache. This reduces cold-start p99 by ~45% in our tests.

Constraints: we have one major reserve roll next week (internal) that could absorb 30% of H100 pool; urgent to know whether Acme will push the pilot date.

Proposed runbook (short):
1) Reserve pilot capacity on May 17 (soft hold)
2) If commit signed by May 24, convert soft hold -> hard reservation and allocate pool
3) If not signed, release soft hold and offer burst credits for 30 days

I'll add the infra numbers into the Drive sheet and tag the "Infra-availability" tab.

Karthik Iyer | Head of Infra Capacity
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

- Procurement: we need an indicative TCO and a short SOC2 summary for legal. Please attach SOC2 summary and a simple statement of data retention for pilot logs.

We can do a quick alignment call tomorrow (Wed) at 9:30 PT if that helps — I put a tentative hold on my calendar.
